states.description: The 50 US states; codes and FIPS remain strings.

datasets.description: Source dataset identity, distinct from a particular release.

sources.description: Immutable source vintage; sha256 describes snapshot_path when saved, or remote bytes for metadata-only records.

districts.description: Research district identity; native IDs live in the dated crosswalk.

schools.description: Research school identity, independent of current district or program.

identifiers.description: Native identifier aliases; time validity is unknown unless explicitly documented.

school_district_history.description: Dated affiliation observations, not inferred continuous district membership.

programs.description: Research program records. Provisional evidence groups are not verified distinct program counts.

program_sites.description: Program-to-school association with separately documented time validity.

program_status_history.description: Dated research assessments of program operation and eligibility, kept separate from the dates of language, design and allocation evidence. Retains closures, future plans and continuity reviews.

operating_status.description: Source/review operating or listing status for this reference year; a listing is not observed implementation.

eligibility_status.description: Separate content-instruction/public-program screening status; confirmed operation alone does not establish study eligibility.

program_languages.description: Language-specific claims; an unreported partner language is never filled with English.

program_configurations.description: Program design and model history at the actual documented grade/year/cohort scope.

allocation_schedules.description: Preserve a policy even when language-specific numeric shares cannot safely be attributed.

evidence_review_status.description: Source-specific review decision. Null means this qualifier was not collected; it does not affirm the policy.

grade_support_status.description: Machine-readable distinction between a grade schedule, model label, earlier-grade proxy and unsupported source. This does not verify tested-cohort exposure.

instructional_allocations.description: One row per named language in a documented schedule; no fixed Spanish/English columns.

evidence_claims.description: Attribute-specific evidence; a confirmed school does not confirm its language allocation.

evidence_period_raw.description: Source applicability exactly as reported, including undated, fiscal-year, multi-year and change-period descriptions. It is separate from source publication date and a study reference year.

reporting_units.description: The actual source aggregation unit, not an inferred instructional track.

populations.description: Preserve source subgroup definitions and the DL/EL distinction.

assessments.description: Instrument and scoring definitions; source-release vintage is recorded separately.

metrics.description: Metric units and population/denominator meaning; proficiency percentages are not interchangeable across states.

observation_program_links.description: Separate associations never duplicate or allocate an observation to a language track.

el_exit_policies.description: Dated exit rules, including domain and non-test requirements; not actual exit outcomes.

coverage.description: State/year/layer collection status; absence in the pilot never means no public data exist.
